# TSMC CoWoS Capacity Expansion Note

**Date:** 2026-11-05  
**Author:** Internal Semi Desk  
**Source Type:** Research Note

## Facts
- TSMC (TSM) accelerated its CoWoS advanced packaging capacity expansion, targeting a 2x increase in monthly wafer capacity by mid-2026.
- NVIDIA remains TSMC's largest CoWoS customer, accounting for roughly 55-60% of allocated high-end packaging supply.

## View
- **Stance:** Bullish on TSMC (strong support).
- TSMC holds near-monopoly pricing power on leading-edge AI wafer and CoWoS packaging, making it a critical 2nd-order beneficiary and bottleneck supplier to NVIDIA.
